name: sentinelflow-platform
description: Distributed Incident Management & Automated Recovery Platform

scripts.start: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "USER,ORDER,PAYMENT,INVENTORY,BANKING,MONITOR,INCIDENT,RECOVERY,NOTIF,GATEWAY,AI" -c "cyan,blue,magenta,yellow,greenBright,red,green,purple,gray,orange,bgMagenta.white" "node services/user-service/index.js" "node services/order-service/index.js" "node services/payment-service/index.js" "node services/inventory-service/index.js" "node services/banking-services/index.js" "node services/monitoring-service/index.js" "node services/incident-service/index.js" "node services/recovery-service/index.js" "node services/notification-service/index.js" "node services/websocket-gateway/index.js" "node services/sentinel-ai/src/index.js"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "USER,ORDER,PAYMENT,INVENTORY,BANKING,MONITOR,INCIDENT,RECOVERY,NOTIF,GATEWAY,AI,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,blue,magenta,yellow,greenBright,red,green,purple,gray,orange,bgMagenta.white,white" "npm run dev -w services/user-service" "npm run dev -w services/order-service" "npm run dev -w services/payment-service" "npm run dev -w services/inventory-service" "npm run dev -w services/banking-services" "npm run dev -w services/monitoring-service" "npm run dev -w services/incident-service" "npm run dev -w services/recovery-service" "npm run dev -w services/notification-service" "npm run dev -w services/websocket-gateway" "npm run dev -w services/sentinel-ai" "npm run dev -w frontend"
